name: io.github.walma-labs/klarna-mcp
description: PLACEHOLDER, NOT YET PUBLISHED. Unofficial Klarna merchant API MCP server: orders, settlements, disputes. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: KLARNA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Klarna API credential username (or use KLARNA_API_KEY)

environmentVariables.name: KLARNA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to username/password: a klarna_<live|test>_api_... key

environmentVariables.name: KLARNA_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register the write tools (capture, refund, extend, cancel, release). Off by default.
